title: Trie: insert, search and delete
summary: Store one character per edge and mark complete words. On deletion, prune the unused suffix while preserving shared prefixes.
triggers: remove a word while keeping longer words searchable
prompts: A command dictionary accepts a new command, then lets the user withdraw it.
Store route names that share prefixes and check whether a complete name is registered.
invariant: A terminal mark represents a complete word even when the node has children.
mantra: Follow the letters, mark the end, prune only empty branches.
pitfalls: An existing path may be just a prefix. Check the terminal marker before deleting.

anchors.name: Implement Trie (Prefix Tree)
anchors.trick: Keep the end marker separate from character edges.

complexity.time: O(m) expected per word of length m
complexity.space: O(total stored characters) for the trie, O(m) deletion path

mutations.explanation: Prunes a prefix that still carries another word.
